sections.title: What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Ready to learn **Introduction to Elementary Programming**?

Here's what we'll cover:

• Overview of elementary programming concepts
• Why this matters for your coding journey
• Hands-on examples you can try

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content:
Think of **Introduction to Elementary Programming** like building blocks. 

Every great program starts with small, simple pieces. This is one of those essential pieces!

• Start simple, then build up
• Practice makes it click
• Don't worry if it takes time - totally normal!

sections.title: Code Examples
Key Points
points: Elementary programming covers variables, data types, input, and basic computation
Programs process data through input, computation, and output
Variables store values in memory that can be used and modified during execution
Data types define what kind of values a variable can hold (integer, decimal, text)
Expressions combine variables, operators, and values to produce results

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: Introduction to Elementary Programming - Overview of elementary programming concepts. Master basics before advancing. Practice with the examples. Builds foundation for what's next.
